title: Work impact at ClinicMind
intro: What I have shipped as a Software Engineer and QA Automation Engineer on ClinicMind's electronic health record (EHR) platform.

stats.label: merge requests merged
stats.detail: 256 in the EHR platform, 184 in the test suite

stats.label: commits on main
stats.detail: 98 merge requests landed in October 2026 alone

stats.label: assigned tickets closed
stats.detail: bug fixes, QA verification and features

highlights.text: Built the walkthrough engine on CDK overlays (spotlight, step cards, skip versus complete), the Page Guides admin editor with live-page anchor picking, per-user progress and funnel events, and the "Ask AI" feedback loop.
Managers, manager groups, weekly and overdue summaries delivered as tasks, a question review queue, and learning paths that assign their knowledge-check steps.
Advanced settings grid read and save on the Node.js back end with rollout flags, a pinned "Find a setting" search, and chip overflow handling.
Email-code sign-in and paperwork steps for public appointment booking, CareConnect portal draft preservation and message threading, telehealth fixes, and portal access-link error messages.
Owner emails after lock-outs, passkey and cookie scoping on dev hosts, PHI audit logging for dashboards and AI Scribe, and fixes for cross-practice chart and mailbox leaks.

Server-sent-event routes that no longer hang the pod on a throw, a reload page instead of a blank app on failed startup, deferred migrations that finish every step, and a run of timezone and daylight-saving corrections.
Twenty-plus fixes in two months: visit patterns, templates, attendance and billing alignment, slot widths, drag-and-drop flicker and placeholder cards.
Merge-request readiness evidence, Storybook screenshot checks, pre-merge periodic spec runs, startup-pin checks and lint coverage for tools and tests.

roles.title: QA Automation Engineer, Playwright smoke-test suite

highlights.lead: ChiroNote test suite, built from zero.
highlights.text: Forty-plus merge requests covering SuperNote-to-ChiroNote salting for vitals, cranial nerves, nerve-root assessment, balance, vestibular and cognitive exams, posture, subluxation, every spinal and extremity region, manual muscle testing, assessment and plan, hard sign-off, chart-widget sync and appointment-type section logic.

highlights.lead: Migration to the new Angular front end.
highlights.text: Converted chart components (nine parts), the XDirect chart widget, field and macro manipulation (sixteen parts), spine diagram, problem list, presenting-problems link-back, sticky notes and care-plan specs.

Introduced shared fixtures for opening notes and loading macros, section-expansion helpers and parameterised page-object locators, then applied them across regression, care-plan and configuration specs.

Fixed CI timeouts, nightly date-boundary failures, hydration and dead-click races, iframe selector drift, and version-gated specs for releases v50 to v56 (and removed the gates once releases rolled out).
Over 200 issues filed, including duplicate patient account numbers, narrative data that failed to salt or render, linkback navigation bugs, telehealth session problems and Help Center editor defects.

highlights.lead: Release coverage inside the platform repo.
highlights.text: Hermetic smoke coverage for ChiroNote validations, formulary and medication administration, fax-on-completion and schedule visuals, plus an auth bootstrap that isolates one rejected login from the rest of the run.

footnote: ClinicMind's repositories are private, so merge requests and issues are not linked here. Counts were taken from the GitLab API and exclude open drafts. ClinicMind, ChiroNote and CareConnect are product names of ClinicMind.
